snippet.title: Fatec's Out | Trailer
snippet.description:
Fatec’s Out is an epic adventure that shows how a digital games professor has to protect the universe’s reality that’s being built beneath his feet. Being a game of the nostalgic and acclaimed Beat’em Up genre, it will make you remember what makes the most famous games of the 90’s timeless.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292920/Fatecs_Out/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/coxinhastudiogames/
